name: shareit
description: Secure peer-to-peer file transfer — WebRTC + AES-GCM-256 + ECDH

scripts.dev: start "ShareIt Backend" cmd /k "cd backend && node --watch server.js" && start "ShareIt Frontend" cmd /k "cd frontend && npm run dev -- --port 3001" && start "ShareIt ML Service" cmd /k "python backend/ml/bg_remover_service.py"
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
